quench level index capped < 10

equipID = ppuVar13[0]; equipRare = ppuVar13[6]; itemLevel = ppuVar13[7]; playerUseLevelMin = ppuVar13[0x12]; playerUseLevelMax = ppuVar13[0x13]

functions.notes: Sentinel 0xdeadbeaf used for missing AS array args. Unreachable-block loop builds material rows (itemID/itemName/requireItemCounts/currentItemCounts/bPointType).

functions.purpose: Builds the equipment enhance/upgrade (enforce) UI data block (param_5==3): source-item stats plus a 'destEquipArray' of candidate upgrade targets, each with full cost/requirement fields. This is the client mirror of the server's upgrade cost table.
formulas: Top-level fields: roleLevel = CPlayer::GetHuntRankOrCount(); roleHunterStarLv = playerObj->vfunc[0x18]() + (FUN_1025b060()+FUN_1025b060()); sourceRare = item->vfunc[0x2c](); itemLevel = item->vfunc[0x18](); ItemRank = FUN_11669840(); bPointType = 1.
Per destEquip record walked at (iStack_20c+0x1c)..(+0x20), stride 0xb0 bytes.
Result array entries laid out at cursor iVar4 (base+0x5c), advancing +0x88 per entry then +0x2c inner. Field offsets relative to iVar4 (the +0x5c anchor of each entry):

equipID = *(e-0x50); enforceRequirement = *(e-0x58); hunterstarRequirement = *(e-0x54); equipRare = *(e-0x38); itemLevel = *(e-0x34); equipCounts = *(e-0x30); upgradeMoney = *(e-0x2c); currentMoney = *(e-0x28); rankDownLevel = *(e-0x24); enforceDownLevel = *(e-0x20); newRankLevel = *(e-0x1c); bBindState = *(e-0x10) (byte); enforceLevel = *(e-0x44); breakLevel = *(e-0x40); canBreak = *(e-0x3c) (byte); enforceRuleID = *(e-0xc).
&DAT_11dbb0b4 field (index) = *(e-0x4c).
Craft-credit cost fields: nCraftCreditID = *(e+4); nOwnCraftCredit = FUN_113fa380(*(e+4)) [owned amount of that craft-credit currency]; nCraftCreditMax = *(e+8); nCraftMoney = *(e+0xc).
equipHasEnoughMaterial hardcoded to 0 here (material sufficiency computed elsewhere).
costs: upgradeMoney (e-0x2c) = gold cost to upgrade; currentMoney (e-0x28) = money threshold/current.
enforceRequirement (e-0x58), hunterstarRequirement (e-0x54) = level/hunter-star gates.
nCraftMoney (e+0xc) craft-credit cost; nCraftCreditMax (e+8) cap; nOwnCraftCredit = FUN_113fa380(creditID) currently-owned.
functions.serverRelevance: validation/display (client shows server-provided upgrade costs & requirements; server must recompute and enforce upgradeMoney/craft cost & requirement gates on the actual upgrade action)
functions.notes: FUN_113fa380(id) is the recurring 'get owned count of currency/material id' accessor used throughout this chunk. The negative-offset cursor layout means each candidate-target record is ~0x88-0xb4 bytes.

functions.purpose: Builds UI VO for a guild-airship / occupied-level entry (param_5==3): guild vs captain comparison, ship status, occupancy players, and the level's reward payload (normal + delicate rewards, material drops).

functions.purpose: 2D config-table lookup into CPlayerVIPLevelUpInfo (VIP level-up thresholds). Returns the config value for a given level index, or 0 if out of range.

PROGRESSION: CharLevel@0x8, CharExp@0xc, StarLevel@0x10, CharHP@0x14, CharMaxHP@0x18, CharStr@0x1c, CharBst@0x20, CharLck@0x24, CharVgr@0x28, CharDefence@0x2c.

CURRENCY: CharMoney@0x30, CharBoundMoney@0x34, CharCredit@0x38, CharBoundCredit@0x3c, CharCatCredit@0xc0, CharReviveCredit@0xc4, PVPMoney@0x196, CharCatMoney@0x19a, CharCatMoneyWeek@0x19e, CharCatMoneyWeekMax@0x1a2, HuntSoul@0x1a6, ClanMoney@0x152, ClanMoneyPVP@0x15e, TotalCredit@0x1ba (stored as FLOAT), HuntingCreditExchange@0x1da, WeekMoneyGain@0x20e.
FATIGUE: CharFatigue@0x40, CharMaxFatigue@0x44.
WEAPON EXP: ClaymoreExp@0x48, HammerExp@0x4c, KatanaExp@0x50, DuelSwordExp@0x54, SwordExp@0x58, SpearExp@0x5c, GunExp@0x60, BowExp@0x64, CrossbowExp@0x68, FluteExp@0x6c.

MISC PROGRESSION: CharContribution@0x84, CharRemainsExp@0x88, CharRemainsDoubleExp@0x114, ExtDailyExp@0xcc, ExtDailyDoubleExp@0x118, FarmExp@0x8e, FarmEvaluation@0x92, IllustratePoint@0x22c, TotalHRPoint@0x1ca, CharHRLevel@0x156, CharHRPoint@0x15a.

VIP: VIPLevel@0x11c, VIPExp@0x120, VIPBaseEndTime@0x124, VIPGrowthEndTime@0x128, VIPProfitEndTime@0x12c, VIPVASFrozen@0x134(i16), VIPBaseCanUse@0x136(i16), VIPGrowthCanUse@0x138(i16), VIPProfitCanUse@0x13a(i16).
CLAN: ClanScore@0x14a, ClanScoreMax@0x14e, ClanLeaveTime@0x162.
WildHuntGuild@0x1b2 also writes sign-extension into +0x1b6 (64-bit value: *(+0x1b6)=value>>0x1f).
SoulStone/PVP scoring: SoulStoneLevel@0x206, SoulStoneAtkLevel@0x212, PersonalELO@0x192, XHunterScore@0x1fa, XHunterHighScore@0x202, MVPPoint@0x1f6, ShouHunPoint@0x1ee, LieHunPoint@0x1f2.
MonopolyRoundCount@0x1e2, MonolopyActivity@0x1e6, MonolopyCurGrid@0x1ea, MonolopyAccStep@0x1fe (spellings as shipped).
costs: Defines the exact persistent fields the server owns and must be authoritative over: CharMoney/CharBoundMoney (gold, unbound/bound), CharCredit/CharBoundCredit (credits), CharCatCredit, CharReviveCredit, PVPMoney, CharCatMoney(+week/weekMax cap), HuntSoul, ClanMoney/ClanMoneyPVP, TotalCredit(float), WeekMoneyGain, plus all *Exp fields.
functions.serverRelevance: authoritative (schema map): although this function is client-side deserialization of server-sent character data, every offset here is a server-owned persistent field. Currency mutations (CharMoney/BoundMoney/Credit/etc.) and all EXP/level fields MUST be computed and validated server-side. CharCatMoneyWeek + CharCatMoneyWeekMax indicate a weekly earn cap the server must enforce.
functions.notes: ~5.9KB linear name->offset dispatch (FUN_100ec310 = string compare). Cross-ref TLV CharacterAttributes.md uses a base 0x14 higher (CharLevel@0x1c vs @0x8 here) — this is a distinct client mirror struct, but field identities match. Bound vs unbound money is a core distinction: BoundMoney/BoundCredit are non-tradeable. TotalCredit is unusually stored as a float.

functions.purpose: Given a current (level=param_1, exp=param_2) and an exp delta (param_3), computes the resulting (level->*param_4, exp->*param_5) by rolling exp over per-level EXP caps. Looks up the CPlayerLevelUpInfo record for the level; the per-level EXP-to-next cap is at entry+0x14. Carries overflow into subsequent levels via FUN_10b629d0(level) (per-level info lookup), stopping at the level cap.
formulas: InfoManager lookup: idx=level-mgr[0x30]; require 0<=idx<mgr[0x24]; block=mgr[0x20][idx/mgr[0x28]]; entry=block[idx%mgr[0x28]] (standard CInfoManager paged pattern)
entry+0x14 = EXP required to advance from this level (per-level cap)
levelCap = *(FUN_1046c7c0(1) + 0xd0); if levelCap <= level return 0xffffffff
if exp+delta < entry[0x14]: outLevel=level, outExp=exp+delta (no level change)

else level-up: carry = (exp - entry[0x14]) + delta; outExp=0; outLevel=level+1; then while true: nextEntry=FUN_10b629d0(outLevel); cap=nextEntry[0x14]; if carry<cap break (outExp=carry); else outLevel++, carry-=cap; stop when outLevel>=levelCap
returns 0 on success, 0xffffffff on error (invalid level / level>=cap / missing entry / exp>=cap)
costs: EXP curve: per-level EXP-to-next stored at CPlayerLevelUpInfo entry+0x14
hard level cap at FUN_1046c7c0(1)+0xd0
functions.serverRelevance: authoritative - this is the exact EXP->level accumulation the server must run to award levels; do not trust client level. Validate against same CPlayerLevelUpInfo curve.

Then tail-calls a virtual (vtable+0xa8), likely a change/notify hook.
formulas: this[9] (level, offset 0x24) += 1
InfoManager lookup for new level: idx=level-mgr[0x30]; entry=mgr[0x20][idx/mgr[0x28]][idx%mgr[0x28]]

costs: CSoulStoneLevelUpInfo entry+0x18 = per-level value added on each level-up (stat/points)

functions.purpose: Initializes a level-reward descriptor object (this=param_1) from a reward-config record (param_3), dispatching on the reward mode at this[0x56] (=param_3[0], values 0-0x12). Reads CLevelRewardInfo entry offsets 0x40/0x44 (local defaults). Sets item/count/probability fields on the descriptor. Handles direct rewards (case 0), grouped rewards (cases 1-9,0xc,0xd,0x10-0x12 via param_3[0xb]), level-encounter group/subgroup rewards (cases 10/0xb/0xe), and a fixed count-1 reward (case 0xf). Returns 1 on success, 0 on failure/unknown mode.
formulas: mode = this[0x56] = param_3[0] (offset 0x158)
CLevelRewardInfo lookup by mode gives local_c=entry[0x40], local_8=entry[0x44] (default group/pool ids)
this[0x57]=param_3[6] (or FUN_1140dd10() default if -1); this[0x58]=param_3[7] (or FUN_1140dce0() default if <1); this[0x59]=param_3[8] (or *(param_2[0x1e]+0x38))
reward output fields: this[0x64]/this[0x65]=item/minCount, this[0x66]/this[0x67]=?/maxCount, this[0x5b]=count, this[0x5c]=rate/probability, this[0x62]=item-list ptr, this[0x5d]=extra

case 0 (direct): this[0x6c..0x70]=param_3[0x20..0x24]; this[0x5c]=param_3[0x26]; this[0x62]=param_3[0x28]; this[0x64]=param_3[0x29]; this[0x65]=param_3[0x2a]; this[0x66]=param_3[0x2b]; this[0x67]=param_3[0x2c]
case 0xf (fixed): this[0x64]=this[0x65]=1, this[0x66]=this[0x67]=0; if (float)param_3[0x26]>0 this[0x5c]=param_3[0x26]; if param_3[0x25]>0 this[0x5b]=param_3[0x25]

override tail: if param_3[0x25]!=0 this[0x5b]=param_3[0x25]; if (float)param_3[0x26]>0 this[0x5c]=param_3[0x26]; if param_3[0x2a]>0 {this[0x64]=param_3[0x29]; this[0x65]=param_3[0x2a]}; if param_3[0x2c]>0 {this[0x66]=param_3[0x2b]; this[0x67]=param_3[0x2c]}
costs: reward item ids, min/max counts, and drop rate/probability (this[0x5c], a float) are populated from CLevelRewardInfo config and param_3 record; exact currency amounts live in the config records
functions.serverRelevance: authoritative - defines what a level reward grants (item ids, counts, probabilities). Server must build/grant from this config, not from client claims.

functions.purpose: Applies an equipment-enchant timed effect. Reads an enchant id/level via vtable+0x3c, looks up CEquipEnchantInfo entry; requires entry+0x34 (effect/buff id) nonzero. If entry+0x30 (duration/threshold) nonzero, reads current value via vtable+0x40 and compares against a counter/time from FUN_10a136c0(); early-returns if already satisfied, else computes a residual. Creates the effect via FUN_115d5b10(effectId, 1, seconds*1000) and stores the handle at param_2+0xc.
formulas: enchantKey = vtable[0x3c](); CEquipEnchantInfo lookup: idx=key-mgr[0x30]; entry=mgr[0x20][idx/mgr[0x28]][idx%mgr[0x28]]
require entry[0x34] != 0 (effect id)
if entry[0x30] != 0: cur=vtable[0x40](); limit=FUN_10a136c0(); if (uint)(entry[0x30]+cur) <= limit return (no-op); residual = (entry[0x30]-limit)+cur
effectHandle = FUN_115d5b10(entry[0x34], 1, residual*1000)  // *1000 = seconds->milliseconds duration
store handle at param_2+0xc
costs: entry+0x34 = enchant effect/buff id; entry+0x30 = base duration/threshold (seconds); effect duration passed as residual*1000 ms
functions.serverRelevance: authoritative - enchant effect id and duration come from CEquipEnchantInfo config; server should compute/grant the timed effect.

functions.purpose: Validates/clamps a requested guild level. this+0x44 holds current guild level. Looks up CGuildLevelUpInfo for that level; if valid, fetches the level record via FUN_108ada90 and reads the level cap at entry+0x14. Clamps the requested param_2 to min(param_2, cap) and stores it at this+0x48. Rejects negative targets. Returns 1.
formulas: if targetLevel(param_2) < 0 return 0
curLevel = this[0x44]; CGuildLevelUpInfo lookup: idx=curLevel-mgr[0x30]; entry=mgr[0x20][idx/mgr[0x28]][idx%mgr[0x28]]
levelRec = FUN_108ada90(this[0x44]); cap = levelRec[0x14]

functions.purpose: Deserializes a guide / beginner-goal definition (wide-char fields) that maps completion counts to reward ids. loop pattern: parse FinishCountN then RewardIdN; if RewardId==0 stop; supports N=1..9
costs: each entry pairs a FinishCount threshold with a RewardId to grant on reaching it (up to 9 tiers)

functions.purpose: Builds, for a league object (param_1), the sorted list of matching round-schedule entries and reward-schedule entries. Iterates CLeagueRoundSchedule table; keeps entries whose entry+0x14 (owner/leagueType) equals the league's virtual-call result (**(*param_1+0x18))(); inserts into a set keyed by entry+0x18 (round order) via a balanced tree (local_34/puStack_30 = red-black-like node walk comparing at offset 4). Collected round ptrs are pushed to vector param_1[0x2c..0x2e], then binary-insertion-sorted (FUN_118447c0 heap/introsort with FUN_11847310 comparator; threshold 0x10/0x40 elements). Then iterates CLeagueRewardSchedule table; keeps entries where entry+0x14 == param_1[5] (league type) AND FUN_118b2170(param_1[6]) passes; pushes to vector param_1[0x2f..0x31] and sorts with FUN_118472f0 comparator (skipped when param_1[5]==4).
formulas: round kept if entry+0x14 == (**(*param_1+0x18))()  (owner match)
reward kept if entry+0x14 == param_1[5] (leagueType) AND FUN_118b2170(param_1[6]) != 0
sort depth = log2(count) via loop halving (iVar5>>=1); introsort threshold count<0x11 -> insertion sort, else heap-partition first 0x40
league type 4 is special-cased (reward list not sorted/built): if (param_1[5] != 4) ...
round vector at param_1[0x2c](begin)/[0x2d](end)/[0x2e](cap); reward vector at [0x2f]/[0x30]/[0x31]; league type at [5], sub-key at [6]
functions.serverRelevance: authoritative (server determines which reward/round schedules apply to a league instance; ordering drives reward distribution)
functions.notes: FUN_118b2170 = time/window predicate; FUN_11847310/118472f0 = sort comparators; FUN_10a1a390/3c0 = string/container init. param_1 is a CLeague* whose vtable+0x18 returns its group id.

functions.purpose: Central client-side FSCommand / console-string dispatcher (~150 cases). functions.purpose: Looks up a reward entry from the level-entrust group reward config (singleton via CLevelEnGroupRewardInfo::GetManager, else CInfoManager::FindByName). Given a global index, resolves a 2D reward table (row pointers array) and returns the reward value at that cell, or 0.

formulas: cfg = singleton or FindByName('CLevelEnGroupRewardInfo'); if missing use default DAT_123bfbfc (lazy-init guarded by DAT_123bfbf8 bit0).
Guard: return 0 unless (param_1 != -1) && ((param_1 != 0 || *(cfg+0x30)==0) && *(cfg+0x28)!=0).
idx = param_1 - *(cfg+0x30) (base index offset); require 0 <= idx < *(cfg+0x24) (total entry count).
row = *(int*)(*(cfg+0x20) + (idx / *(cfg+0x28)) * 4)  where cfg+0x28 = columns-per-row / stride; if row==0 return 0.
return *(int*)(row + (idx % *(cfg+0x28)) * 4).
costs: returns a reward id/value from the group reward matrix (row-major, stride = cfg+0x28)
functions.notes: cfg layout: +0x20 row-pointer array base, +0x24 total count, +0x28 stride(cols), +0x30 base-index offset. Reward matrix is [ceil(count/stride)] rows x [stride] cols.

Server must authoritatively enforce these caps and item consumption.

Each writes str/int unlock fields when the player's value < required (*(rec+4)).

functions.purpose: Builds the hub-page level list VO (param_5==7). Depending on selector local_19c (1=entry,4=raid,2=king,3=letter,5=star-level,7=other) calls CMHLevelInfo::CollectHub*Configs, then per level writes many display fields (levelID, levelMod, levelShowType, levelLockType, isReward, isStarHunt, appraisal, bDoubleReward, maxLimited, isElite, unlock conditions, next-level indices, BossName/LevelName).
formulas: selector dispatch on local_19c: 1->CollectHubEntryConfigs, 4->CollectHubRaidConfigs, 2->CollectHubKingQuests, 3->CollectHubLetterQuests, 5->CollectHubPageStarLevelQuests, 7->FUN_1130bcd0

per-level element stride = 0x20 dwords (0x80 bytes): fields at [0]=levelID, [1]=levelMod, [2]=levelPointIndex, [4]=isValidLevel/levelShowType, [5]=levelDifficultType, [6]=levelIconName-related, [0xc]=levelLockType, [0xd]=maxLimited, +0x1d(byte)=isElite-flag, [0x14/0x15]=unlock-condition range, [0x17/0x18]=arrayNextLevelIndex range, [0x1a]=SubPageID, [0x1b]=strSubPageTitle key, [0x1e/0x1f]=star/priority sort keys
isReward = *(byte*)(elem+7); isReward reward id resolved via FUN_10976e80 (CLevelRewardInfo grid) then FUN_10976ff0
'best/highlight' level pick: keeps elem with higher [0x1f] (or equal [0x1f] and higher pppppiStack_174 vs [0x1e]) when [0xc]==0 (unlocked)
functions.serverRelevance: client-only: UI list builder reading server-authoritative CMHLevelInfo config and unlock/reward state.

functions.purpose: Scans all hubs (outer) and up to 32 chapters (inner) to find the first unclaimed hub-completion reward and reports it to UI (hubId, chapterInfo, numReward, rewardId, stateReward). If none pending, reports terminal state 2.
formulas: outer loop bound = FUN_10976b80() (hub count); hub obj = FUN_10976af0(hubIdx); inner loop 0..0x20 (32) chapters; chapter = FUN_116b8a70(i)
rewardId = hubObj->vtbl[+0x18](chapter+4, &iStack_54); reward state iStack_50 = FUN_1130c880(playerLevelObj local_2c, rewardId)
emit when rewardId>0 (iStack_54>0) && state!=1: stateReward = (rewardId==-1)?0:1; else if all hubs exhausted (hubCount<=hubIdx): report chapterInfo=-1, rewardId=-1, stateReward=2
iStack_50 init -5 sentinel; state==1 means already claimed
functions.serverRelevance: validation: client computes which reward to show/request; server must authoritatively decide claim eligibility (state) and grant. Client display of stateReward is advisory.

functions.purpose: Builds an ITEM_VO itemList view-object (param_5==2) by scanning the player's bag across bag types {0,2,10} and matching items whose base-item id equals a target material id (from FUN_11669250 -> +0x10). Writes per-item VO fields: id, count, asset, collumn(slot), isBind, m_nBindType, m_nFactItemLevel, and if transmogrify-capable m_nTransmogrifyItemId + quench fields.
formulas: bag-type set auStack_18 = {0, 2, 10}; per type slotCount = FUN_113f92a0(type); item = FUN_113f9bb0(type, slotIdx)
match: candidate base id (from op-struct +0x10 via FUN_11669250) == target; count via item->vtbl[+0xc]()
isBind = (piVar3[8] != 0); m_nBindType = FUN_116693d0(); m_nFactItemLevel = item->vtbl[+0x18]()

quench block only if FUN_116698a0()!=0 (transmog-capable): m_nTransmogrifyItemId = piVar3[0x7d]; item def via FUN_1052bdd0; m_bCanQuench = (def+0x28c != 0); m_nMaxQuenchLevel = def+0x290; m_nQuenchLevel = (short)piVar3[0x7e]
functions.serverRelevance: client-only: read-only bag view builder; bag contents are server-authoritative.

functions.purpose: Builds an ITEM_VO itemList (param_5==5) scanning bag types {0,2,10} filtered by item category fields (rareType iStack_78 at def+0x34, typeNormal piStack_74 at def+0x38, typeSub iStack_a0/iStack_7c at def+0x3c). Emits richer VO incl. m_typeNormal, m_typeSub, m_nRareType.
formulas: bag types {0,2,10}; slotCount=FUN_113f92a0(type); item=FUN_113f9bb0(type,slot)

filter: (iStack_78<0 || iStack_78==def+0x34) && (piStack_74<0 || piStack_74==def+0x38); typeSub match: if iStack_7c==-1 use iStack_a0==def+0x3c; else if iStack_a0>=0 && iStack_a0!=def+0x3c && iStack_7c>=0 use iStack_7c==def+0x3c
sentinel -0x21524151 (0xDEADBEAF-like) marks 'no filter'; def field offsets +0x10(id) +0x34(rareType) +0x38(typeNormal) +0x3c(typeSub) +0xb4(asset) +0x4c(rareType alt)
quench fields identical to 1097fd80 (m_bCanQuench def+0x28c, m_nMaxQuenchLevel def+0x290, m_nQuenchLevel (short)piVar3[0x7e]); m_nRareType from item->vtbl[+0x2c]() when transmog-capable else def+0x4c
functions.serverRelevance: client-only: bag view builder with category filter; contents server-authoritative.

RedTeamScore=battle+0x54, BlueTeamScore=battle+0x58, PlayerLevel=self+0x408, Score=self+0x40c, CatCar=self+0x414
league fields read from player+0x9880.. : LeagueType=[0x9880], LeagueScoreChange=[0x9881], LeaguePowerChange=[0x9882], LeagueSelfScoreChange/CoinChange=[0x9883]; [0x9884..0x988a] rank/pic state
LeagueCoinCurrent = FUN_1025b060(); LeagueCoinChange = iStack_c8 ([0x9883])

rank-band (LeagueType==4 only): tier = score/100 + 1; iStack_d0 = maxScore/100+1, iVar7 = curScore/100+1; LeagueCurSelRankScore = (maxScore/100+1)*100 - maxScore (points to next band); band-transition code: ==->1, cur<prev->3, prev<cur->2, else 0
Items list built from in_stack_00000018 pairs {id, count} stride 4 dwords as BaseItemVo(id,count)
costs: LeagueCoinCurrent snapshot = FUN_1025b060(); LeagueCoinChange = league coin delta awarded this match (server-computed)
functions.serverRelevance: client-only: settlement UI. All scores, coin deltas, reward Items and rank transitions are server-authoritative; this function only renders them.
